title: 先進製程控制與虛擬量測
titleEn: Advanced process control and virtual metrology
summary: 從閉迴路邊界、時間切割到版本回復：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Closed-loop boundary and Temporal splitting to Version rollback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 閉迴路邊界 → 資料時間戳
stages.description: 把「閉迴路邊界」「Run-to-run 控制」「資料時間戳」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Closed-loop boundary, Run-to-run control, Data timestamps.

steps.title: 閉迴路邊界：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor.
steps.instruction: 畫設定、製程、實測、估測及控制器的訊號方向。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw setpoint, process, measurement, prediction and controller signal paths. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器；回授與前饋使用不同資訊時點。
steps.observationEn: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor; Feedback and feedforward use different timing.
steps.failure: 若採用「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Calling a prediction a physical measurement", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「閉迴路邊界」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Closed-loop boundary diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor.

knowledge.title: 閉迴路邊界／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor.

knowledge.title: 閉迴路邊界／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Calling a prediction a physical measurement.

quiz.question: 關於「閉迴路邊界」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Closed-loop boundary, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器
預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到
不知增益正負就直接反覆加大修正
optionsEn: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor
Calling a prediction a physical measurement
Escalating corrections without knowing gain sign
quiz.explanation: 虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 閉迴路邊界：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Calling a prediction a physical measurement.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「閉迴路邊界」成果，先指出錯誤主張「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：回授與前饋使用不同資訊時點。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Closed-loop boundary artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Calling a prediction a physical measurement". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Feedback and feedforward use different timing. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器；回授與前饋使用不同資訊時點。
steps.observationEn: Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor; Feedback and feedforward use different timing.
steps.failure: 若採用「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Calling a prediction a physical measurement", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「閉迴路邊界」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「回授與前饋使用不同資訊時點」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Closed-loop boundary, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Feedback and feedforward use different timing" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 閉迴路邊界／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：回授與前饋使用不同資訊時點。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Feedback and feedforward use different timing.

knowledge.title: 閉迴路邊界／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「預測值存在就可宣稱已實際量到」與「虛擬量測是推估，不是新增實體感測器」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Calling a prediction a physical measurement" is not equivalent to "Virtual metrology is inference, not another physical sensor"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: Run-to-run 控制：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
steps.instruction:
用假設線性增益將上一片誤差換成下一片小幅修正。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設無延遲、無雜訊的教學模型 y=2u+1，現在 u=4 得 y=9，目標 y*=11。以模型反算 Δu=(11−9)/2=1，故下次 u=5、預測 y=11。若真實斜率不是 2 或量測有延遲，這次修正可能過度；這是紙上控制練習，不能作機台指令。
steps.instructionEn:
Convert prior-wafer error to a bounded next-run correction. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a delay-free noise-free teaching model y=2u+1. Current u=4 gives y=9; target y*=11. Model inversion gives Δu=(11−9)/2=1, so next u=5 predicts y=11. A different real slope or delayed measurement can cause overcorrection. This is a paper control exercise, not a machine command.
steps.observation: 控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向；增益估計錯誤可放大振盪。
steps.observationEn: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign; Gain-estimation errors can amplify oscillation.
steps.failure: 若採用「不知增益正負就直接反覆加大修正」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Escalating corrections without knowing gain sign", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「Run-to-run 控制」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：控制更新有延遲且需要製程增益方向。
算例驗收：驗算 u=5，並以斜率改為 3 的另一假設檢查模型失配為何改變控制增益。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Run-to-run control diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Updates have delay and need the correct gain sign.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify u=5 and use an alternative slope of 3 to explain why model mismatch changes the required control gain.
